rawText: The spirit of the Earth heals you. Place 2 discarded cards at the bottom of your life deck. Discard from the game after use.

name: Unselfish Behavior is Best
rawText: The efforts of your allies stop this combat. You must have an ally out on the table to use this card. Discard from the game after use.

name: Hero Advantage
rawText: Allows a hero to draw his cards from the top of the discard deck in the next combat. If there are not enough cards, the drill does not work. Discard from the game after use.

name: Saiyan Honor Quest
rawText: In the next combat draw cards from the bottom of the discard pile instead of the Life Deck. Discard after one use.

name: Saiyan Battle Terms
rawText: Remove a Non-Combat Card or ally from in front of another player from the game. Discard this card from the game after use.

name: Saiyan Appraisal Maneuver
rawText: Name a Non-Combat card and foes with any in their decks must discard them from the game. Discard this card from the game after use.

name: Dream Fighting
rawText: This combat ends and the defender places the bottom discarded card back at the bottom of his life deck. Discard this card from the game after use.

name: Cutting the Tail
rawText: Reduce the defending main personality's anger level to (0). Discard this card from the game after use.

name: The Tail Grows Back
rawText: Increase the personality's power stage to its maximum level. Discard this card from the game after use.

name: Goku's Lucky Break
rawText: Draw an unused Dragon Ball from your life deck and place it down. Shuffle the life deck afterwards.

name: Saiyan Truce Card
rawText: Stops this combat. The turn ends, and the player may hold all his extra cards until his next turn. Discard from the game after use.

name: Battle Pausing
rawText: The attacker draws 2 cards from his discard pile. The defender raises 5 stages if possible.

name: Grabbing the Tail
rawText: Reduce the foe's power level by 4 stages, or to (0), whichever happens first. Discard this card from the game after use.

name: Nappa's Blinding Stare
rawText: The attacker is temporarily blinded and this combat stops. Discard this card from the game after use.

name: Power Gifting
rawText: One ally gives your main personality power on a stage for stage basis, reducing their total and boosting your main personality's. Discard from the game after use.

name: Terrible Wounds
rawText: Place this on a foe's personality card. Reset the personality's anger to (0). It cannot go up until after he forces another player to discard a life card. Discard this from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Broken Scouter
rawText: Your power level was miscounted. Raise it to full power. Discard this from the game after use.

name: Raditz Flying Kick
rawText: Physical attack doing triple the usual damage if successful.

name: Tien Mind Reading Trick
rawText: This card stays on the table. If Tien is in play, all villains must show their hands face up at all times.

name: Piccolo's Flight
rawText: Stops a successful physical or energy attack.

name: Plant Two Saibaimen
rawText: A villain may plant this card instead of combat. On his next turn, he takes his highest level Saibaimen and puts it into play as an ally. Discard this card from the game after use.

name: Gohan's Father Save
rawText: If Gohan is Goku's ally, he stops the foe's combat turn. Discard after use.

name: Krillin's Drill
rawText: Does an extra life card of damage with each successful attack. More than 1 of these drills can be out at the same time.

name: Krillin's Energy Disk
rawText: Energy attack doing 4 life cards of damage at a cost of 1 stage.

name: Ribs Broken
rawText: Discard an ally from the game to make an energy attack. The foe takes 5 life cards of damage.

name: Unexpected Allies
rawText: Pull an ally card from the discards or the life deck, play it and set its power stages at full.

name: Raditz Energy Burst
rawText: Energy attack doing 2 draws from the life card deck if not stopped and costing no power stages to perform.

name: Vegeta's Stance
rawText: Prevents all but 1 life card draw from a successful energy attack. Discard from the game after use.

name: Vegeta's Quickness Drill
rawText: At the beginning of each combat, draw 1 card from the bottom of the discard pile to use.

name: Bulma Finds a Dragon Ball
rawText: When the Bulma ally is in play, use this card to capture a Dragon Ball. Discard from the game after use.

name: Bulma Finds a Drill
rawText: When the Bulma ally is in play, pick a drill from the life deck or the discards and put it into play.

name: Baba Witch Viewing Drill
rawText: Forces every Villain opponent to constantly show his hand of cards face up at all times.

name: Baba's Energy Blast
rawText: Does 3 life card discards in damage at any time to a foe. Discard this card from the game after 1 use.

name: T-Rex Defense
rawText: The beast takes all damage from physical attacks for the card user, but the first energy attack kills it. Discard from the game after 1 use.

name: T-Rex Offense
rawText: In every battle where the card owner is attacking, it does 1 life card in damage per combat until an energy attack kills it.

name: Vegeta's Plans
rawText: Get a Dragon Ball card from the life deck and put it into play. Remove from game after one use.

name: Ally Wins!
rawText: This card does 1 life card in damage to a foe for every ally the card user has. Discard from the game after use.

name: Chiaotzu's Drill
rawText: Allows the user to duck and miss the first stage of damage in a physical attack.

name: Goku's Mixing Drill
rawText: Allows multiple colors of drills to be used at the same time.

name: Red Life Attack Drill
rawText: Drill does an extra life card of damage whenever successful damage is done.

name: Blue Life Defense Drill
rawText: Drill prevents 1 life card of damage from being taken whenever a successful attack happens on the card owner.

name: Orange Focusing Drill
rawText: Prevents anything from happening to a personality's drills until he advances to his next level.

name: Black Shadow Drill
rawText: Allows the card owner to take 2 less stages of power drain from a successful physical attack.

name: Saiyan Power Drill
rawText: In all physical attacks the card owner does an extra 2 stages of power draining damage.

name: Goku's Capturing Drill
rawText: Prevents any Dragon Ball from being captured from this drill user.

name: King Kai's Calming
rawText: Played at the end of a turn, it forces a foe back from level 3 to level 2. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Roshi's Calming
rawText: Played at the end of a turn, it forces a foe back from level 2 to level 1. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Vegeta's Trick
rawText: Find the foe's first Dragon Ball in his life deck and place it at the bottom of his deck. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Vegeta's Dragon Ball Capture
rawText: Capture 2 of a foe's Dragon Balls and place them at the bottom of his life deck. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Dream Machine Battle
rawText: This battle never happened. Start all over with new cards and reset all damage to beginning levels. Limit 1 per deck.
